title: Agent Council
markdown:
**What it is:** The configuration hub for the specialists behind the Executive — the place to tune how each one thinks and how the Executive sounds.

**What it does:**

- Pick any agent and add instructions, or override its role, system prompt, model, or deep-reasoning toggle.
- Set the Executive's **voice persona** — the tone it speaks to you in.
- Test a draft configuration with a one-off query before committing.
- View version history and roll back, or reset an agent to its built-in default.

**How to use:**

1. Open **Settings → Advanced → Agent Council**. It opens in a simple view: **Quality** at the top sets every agent's model and deep reasoning at once. Under **Your agents**, each main agent is a card with its area and model; an amber dot and **Has your instructions** mean you've already changed it. Click a card to open that agent in a panel with its **Additional instructions**, then click **Save** (or **Cancel**). **Show all agents** lists the internal ones too.
2. For everything else, click **Advanced** at the top (the browser remembers it; **Back to simple view** returns). Click an agent's card; its panel splits the settings into tabs — **Model**, **Instructions**, **Prompt**, **Test** and **History**:
   - **Role** — its one-line job description.
   - **Model** — provider and model; the default is marked *(default)*.
   - **Deep reasoning** — slower, more thorough thinking (not available on Haiku models).
   - **Additional instructions** — a few lines added after its built-in prompt, such as "Quote figures in EUR". The agent keeps getting improvements to its built-in prompt. Clear the box to remove them.
   - **System prompt** — its full instructions. Editing it replaces the built-in prompt, so later improvements to it won't reach this agent; prefer **Additional instructions** when you can. **Restore default prompt in editor** brings the original back.
   - **Research focus** — specialists only.
3. Try it before saving: on the **Test** tab, under **Test this draft**, type a question and click **Run test**. It uses your unsaved settings and changes nothing.
4. Click **Save** at the bottom of the panel. The change applies on the next call.
5. To undo, choose **Reset to default** in the **⋯** menu at the bottom of the agent's panel, or open the **History** tab and click **Restore** on an earlier version.

*Change the Executive's voice:* pick one under **Voice** on **Settings → Your Executive**. To write your own, open the Council's **Advanced** view, click the **Executive** card and open the **Prompt** tab: **Voice Persona** there has the **Active persona** (save it with the main **Save**), and **+ New**, which asks for a display name and a persona body — then click **Create** — or **Duplicate** an existing persona and edit the copy.

**Example persona body:**

```
- Direct and brief; lead with the recommendation, then the reasoning
- Plain English, no jargon or buzzwords
- Numbers over adjectives
- End with the one decision you need from me
```

*Note: changes take effect on the next call — no restart needed. This is a power-user surface under Settings.*
